In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]], the ruler of the Sith princedom known as the [[Daimanate]], used a '''transport''' to transport the village leaders of the six mining towns of [[Chelloa]] following the discovery of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]]. The transport had at least one bright navigation light and was piloted by two [[Daimanate Sith trooper]]s. The vessel was dark blue with a few red stripes. It also had four rear thruster engines.

During her [[Second Raid on Daiman's compound|second raid]] on [[Daiman's compound]], Kerra stowed aboard the ship and used it to infiltrate Daiman's palace. Upon landing, she freed the village leaders and killed their escorting Sith troopers. She then rescued [[Gorlan Palladane]], a fellow [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and the leader of the [[Chelloan resistance]]. Kerra and the freed village leaders then traveled to [[Arboth]] where they evacuated Chelloa's population using a fleet of freighters known as the [[Freedom Fleet]]. Due to Kerra and Palladane's efforts, they managed to evacuate 60,000 Chelloans to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] space prior to the [[Destruction of Chelloa]].
